Subject: Budget range validation - PayBridge (token volumes & procurement)

Hi Jamie - great convo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can prepare a formal quote and procurement-ready materials:

Call recap
- Primary use: in-product assistant for payments support and reconciliation automation.
- Expected ramp: pilot in Q3, full rollout in Q4.
- Key constraints: procurement onboarding + SOC2 evidence for anything >$20k/month.

What I need from you (quick answers will do):
1) Expected monthly token volume range (low / mid / high) for month 1 and steady-state.
2) Any internal procurement thresholds (card vs PO vs SOW). You mentioned procurement steps - can you confirm the $/month bands?
3) Billing and legal contacts (procurement@ or vendor onboarding team).

Attached is a simple spend template - fill the cells with your best estimates and send back. Based on similar customers, we usually present 3 pricing bands:
- Pilot: <$5k/month (self-serve/card)
- Growth: $5k-$20k/month (sales-assisted, PO accepted)
- Enterprise: >$20k/month (requires procurement onboarding + SOW)

Preliminary unit economics to validate on your side: target list-level unit = $95 / 1M tokens (standard hosted), volume discounts at commit levels. Example: 50M tokens -> ~$4.75k/mo; 200M tokens -> ~$19k/mo (before discounts).

Next steps
- Jamie: send back the completed template and procurement contact.
- I'll produce an initial price band and a procurement-ready quote + SOC2/attestation pack.

Thanks - Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap. Quick answers below and I've attached a rough usage estimate in the template you sent.

Usage estimates (Month 1 / steady-state)
- Low: 40M / 50M tokens/month
- Mid: 120M tokens/month
- High: 200M tokens/month

Token assumptions: ~2.5k active daily users for pilot, average 400 tokens per session, expected growth to ~12k DAU in steady-state.

Procurement thresholds
- <$5k/month: charge card ok
- $5k–$20k/month: finance prefers PO, quick vendor setup (standard terms)
- >$20k/month: requires vendor onboarding, security questionnaire, and an executed SOW/PO.

Procurement contact: procurement@paybridge.com (they handle vendor onboarding).

Happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

—Jamie

Thanks for the numbers, Jamie - super helpful. I put together a concise pricing note and unit-econ examples so your procurement and finance teams can validate quickly. See the highlights below and the attached PDF for a downloadable quote template.

Unit economics (examples using $95 / 1M tokens list price)
- 40M tokens -> $3,800/month
- 50M tokens -> $4,750/month
- 120M tokens -> $11,400/month
- 200M tokens -> $19,000/month

Suggested billing bands & procurement path (recommended)
- Pilot: <$5k/month - self-serve; minimal paperwork; card billing.
- Growth: $5k–$20k/month - sales-assisted; PO accepted; standard vendor setup (2–3 weeks).
- Enterprise: >$20k/month - procurement kickoff, security pack (SOC2 + data flow), signed SOW/PO.

Discounting notes: we can provide tiered discounts at commit levels (e.g., 10–25% off at multi-month/annual commits). I'll include a commit-backed pricing table in the formal quote.

Attachments: Pricing_options_paybridge.pdf (contains banded quote + example SOW checklist).

Next steps
1) I'll route the formal quote to procurement@paybridge.com and include SOC2 evidence and our data flow diagram.
2) If procurement confirms the >$20k onboarding requirement, we'll include a tentative SOW.
3) Can you confirm who signs contracts (name + title) and approximate PO lead time?

If helpful, Dylan and I can join a short procurement sync to expedite vendor onboarding.

Best - Marissa
